reason: Independent full review: the four pinned hashes and splitlines counts match, and all four numbered files were read through EOF, including the new Accounts v2 and retained Customers v1 one-time/subscription examples and both webhook versions. Every quote and old excerpt matches its cited line, and Q1/Q2 are substantive answers. The receipt correctly calls for qualified identity branches, server-owned entitlement state, and a warning about the new customer_account versus session.customer mismatch. It still recommends webhook-led credit on checkout.session.completed without the paid-status/async-method guard found in related Checkout authority, and it overlooks a block-scope error that makes the shared webhook example fail before either identity lookup can run.
required_changes: Qualify the fulfillment finding, historical-preservation guidance, conflict, and Q2 for delayed-notification payment methods: new raw lines 417 and 524 allow additional dynamic payment methods, while wiki/sources/source-stripe-checkout-dashboard-payment-methods.md lines 22-34 says checkout.session.completed can mean form submission with payment_status unpaid; grant credits only when paid, or on checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded for delayed methods, and handle async failure. The success_url and a completed event alone must not become proof of paid funds. Related wiki/concepts/stripe-checkout.md lines 140 and 202-204 already capture this guard, though its line 212 shorthand should be read with that qualification.

Add the inherited webhook sample's executable scope failure to findings/conflicts and the unresolved implementation warning: old raw lines 447-474 and new raw lines 641-668 declare let event inside if (webhookSecret) but read event.data.object after that block, even though data was extracted for either branch. As written, the sample cannot reliably reach fulfillment; avoid presenting it as a working implementation for either Customer v1 or Accounts v2. Keep the separate customer_account/session.customer identity mismatch flagged.
